items.title: Deere Q3 2026 earnings: profit rises as construction offsets farm weakness
items.summary: The equipment maker raised its full-year net income forecast to $4.75 billion–$5 billion after its construction and forestry segment posted an 84% jump in operating profit

items.title: Premarket movers: Deere jumps following upbeat Q3, Wolfspeed plunges
items.summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock futures were little changed on Thursday, as a rally in government bonds lost momentum and investors assessed a fresh batch of corporate earnings and analyst actions.

items.title: Deere (DE) Beats Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
items.summary: Deere (DE) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +6.47% and +1.77%, respectively, for the quarter ended July 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Deere shares rise as fiscal Q3 earnings and revenue beat forecasts
items.summary: Deere & Co. (NYSE:DE) shares gained more than 3% in premarket trading on Thursday after the agricultural equipment manufacturer delivered fiscal third-quarter results that exceeded Wall Street expectations on both revenue and earnings.

items.title: Deere shares climb as fiscal Q3 earnings and revenue top estimates
items.summary: Investing.com -- Deere & Co. shares rose over 3% in premarket trading Thursday after the agricultural equipment maker posted a fiscal third-quarter results beat, with revenue and earnings both topping Wall Street estimates.

items.title: Deere’s Profit Rises as Sales Climb
items.summary: The company posted higher profit and sales in its fiscal third quarter, as continued growth in the company’s construction equipment business helped to offset ongoing weakness in its production agriculture segment.

items.title: Deere (NYSE:DE) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations
items.summary: Agricultural and construction machinery company Deere (NYSE:DE) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4.9% year on year to $12.61 billion. Its GAAP profit of $5.10 per share was 8.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Deere Stock Rises. Agriculture Is Weak, but Earnings Are Strong.
items.summary: The agricultural machinery maker posts fiscal third quarter earnings per share of $5.10 from agricultural equipment sales of about $7.4 billion.
